title: 662. Solve the Equation

examples.explanation: The left side groups to 2x+2 and the right side to x+4, so x = 2.

hints: Parse each side separately into (x-coefficient, constant) by scanning sign by sign.
A missing number before x means 1; a lone sign before x means +1 or -1.
Move everything to one side: (lc - rc) * x = rconst - lconst, then branch on a zero coefficient.
